string.text:
“Sunset Sarsaparilla” is a carbonated root beer drink.
The Sunset Sarsaparilla Company was founded in 1918 and became known across the former United States for its non-alcoholic sarsaparilla-flavored soda.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
%c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] beverage
%c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] imported
%c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] high quality
%c[d_red] • %c[ui_gray_2] may cause kidney failure
 
%c[ui_gray_3]Drink to reset all traits
“You really don't need to reload after firing only two rounds from a 30-round magazine...”\n \nYou reload assault rifles, sniper rifles, and shotguns 15% faster.
“If you're bleeding, you know what to do.”\n \nPredator now also improves weapon handling. \\nReload and draw weapons up to 25% faster.
“You carefully butcher mutant corpses to get more loot.”\n \nYou have a 50% higher chance to get an extra mutant part when butchering.
“You know how to bargain with strangers.”\n \nPrices are 5% better at traders from other factions.
“Traders from your faction are always happy to see you.”\n \nPrices are 5% better at traders from your own faction.
“What's in the box?”\n \nThe difficulty of picking locks on closed containers is reduced by 10%.
“Who needs friends anyway?”\n \nWhen you have no companions, your carry weight increases by 5 kg and damage received is reduced by 10%.
“Grab some ammo and just stick it in there.”\n \nMagazine loading is 25% faster.
“Unloading every magazine you find seems like a good idea.”\n \nMagazines unload 30% faster.
“Congratulations, you found a cure for bullet holes.”\n \nUsing medicine briefly grants +10% general health recovery and radiation removal.
“With a knife in hand, even explosions somehow hurt less.”\n \nYou take 20% less physical damage while holding a melee weapon.
“Why waste ammo when you can just hit them?”\n \nYou deal 15% more melee damage to mutants.
“Your skin has toughened from fighting mutants.”\n \nYou take 10% less damage from mutant attacks.
“You really don't need to pick up everything...”\n \nCarry weight increases by 10%. \\nSprint speed decreases by 5%.
“AAAAAAAH!”\n \nTaking damage increases movement speed for 10 seconds, \\nup to 25%.
“AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!”\n \nPain Rush now also increases stamina recovery by up to 5% per second. \\nPain Rush lasts 5 seconds longer.
“I don't have time to bleed.”\n \nKilling stalkers or mutants reduces bleeding by 5% for 10 seconds.
“Your mind isn't what it was when you first entered the Zone...”\n \nYou take 25% less damage from Controller psi attacks.
“Remember, drawing a pistol is always faster than reloading.”\n \nYou holster weapons 25% faster and draw pistols 50% faster.
“Drop the gun... and the magazine!”\n \nYou reload pistols and submachine guns 25% faster.

“I need to run faster...
I don't want to get caught in an emission.”
 
Sprint speed increases by 8%. \nCarry weight decreases by 3%.
“Exploring the Zone is safer with a gunner... I mean, a companion!”\n \nYour companions deal 15% more damage and take 25% less damage.

“I need to walk faster...
I don't want to be late for the meeting.”
 
Walking speed increases by 6%. \nCarry weight decreases by 1 kg.
“Your spine got stronger from carrying rookies on your back!”\n \nCarry weight increases by 4 kg.

“Maybe it's radiation or just the Zone, but your skull has grown tougher...”
 
You take 10% less damage from headshots.
Trader prices are 3% worse.
“You wouldn't need to repair your suit so often if you just stopped getting shot.”\n \nYou have a 15% higher chance not to use repair supplies when fixing body armor or helmets.
“Stalkers envy your perfectly maintained gear.”\n \nYou have a 25% higher chance not to use a repair kit when fixing parts and tools.
“Full-auto fire at tushkanos takes its toll on weapons.”\n \nYou have a 15% higher chance not to use repair supplies when repairing weapons.
